findings.title: One inbox reduces app switching
findings.impact: Users can keep up with people across services and report less effort replying.
findings.action: Keep one inbox with clear source and account labels; include Gmail, Outlook and Teams in the connection plan.
findings.test: Receive synthetic conversations from two qualified providers and reply without selecting the wrong account.

findings.title: Messaging without addictive feeds
findings.impact: People keep social contact while avoiding reels, status feeds and doomscrolling; one reviewer describes easier follow-through with ADHD.
findings.action: Keep MINI focused on conversations and user-chosen attention; no algorithmic social feed.
findings.test: A message can be found and answered without entering a provider feed; compare workflow effort with native apps.

findings.title: Consistent interface and easy setup for some
findings.impact: Familiar presentation and good performance can make many networks feel manageable, although other users disagree.
findings.action: Use a consistent Android-native interface, legible text labels and a guided first account setup.
findings.test: Observe a first-time user connecting an account and finding a chat without coaching.

findings.title: Person merging and Matrix interoperability
findings.impact: Merging reduces duplicate contacts but can obscure where messages came from; Matrix openness interests some users.
findings.action: Explore optional user-confirmed person linking; preserve provider/account identity and reversible separation. Do not merge by display name.
findings.test: Two same-named people remain separate; linked threads retain source badges and the correct reply route.
findings.qualification: Distinctive capabilities in this sample, not a claim of market exclusivity

findings.title: Notifications arrive only when opened
findings.impact: Users miss time-sensitive messages even after trying battery settings. This undermines the entire hub.
findings.action: Prove background intake and OS notifications independently of the heavy AI model; expose stale/disconnected sources.
findings.test: Compare synthetic messages with provider truth while screen off, backgrounded, restarted and under OS battery restrictions; record delivery gaps.

findings.title: Repeated disconnections and painful reconnection
findings.impact: Reauthorization friction makes the hub harder than using native apps; some users cannot sign back in.
findings.action: Provide per-account health, safe reconnect, preserved local history, and explicit reauthorization steps.
findings.test: Expire/revoke one account, reconnect it, and verify other accounts and prior local context stay intact.

findings.title: Unclear sending state and failed delivery
findings.impact: A spinner may persist after actual delivery; blind retries could duplicate a message.
findings.action: Represent pending, confirmed, failed and unknown delivery honestly; reconcile provider IDs before retrying.
findings.test: Interrupt connectivity after submission, reconcile the result, and prove no duplicate send.

findings.title: History disappears or new chats are absent
findings.impact: Users lose access to old context or cannot see a new conversation until opened elsewhere.
findings.action: Publish provider-specific history coverage, preserve reconnect history and detect incomplete sync.
findings.test: Reconnect and paginate synthetic old/new chats; verify deduplication, persistence, correct coverage labels and no invented complete-history claim.

findings.title: Muted and archived chats do not stay that way
findings.impact: Unwanted groups reappear or become noisy after updates; users lose trust in their own settings.
findings.action: Persist MINI attention choices; explicitly choose whether new messages reopen archives. Keep provider mute and MINI mute distinct.
findings.test: Sync, restart, update and receive a new group message; verify the user-selected mute/archive policy remains unchanged.

findings.title: Long inboxes and hidden network filters
findings.impact: All chats together can become overwhelming; an existing filter is ineffective if people cannot find it.
findings.action: Make source/account filters, low priority and search visible; add optional labels without burying basic navigation.
findings.test: Ask a first-time user to find a work account and low-priority chat; measure completion and wrong turns.
findings.qualification: Developer reply on p8 says network filtering existed; this is also a discoverability problem

findings.title: Icon-only redesign and oversized pinned chats
findings.impact: Users lose familiar navigation or must open pinned chats to see the latest message.
findings.action: Use text with icons, compact pinned rows with previews, accessible font scaling and stable navigation.
findings.test: At large text size, show sender, account, latest preview and unread state without clipping or excessive taps.

findings.title: Reply targets, quotes and mentions are wrong or unclear
findings.impact: Messages can address the wrong context, leave stale quoted replies or corrupt a tagged name.
findings.action: Show the exact replied-to message and reset the composer after confirmed send; qualify mentions per connector.
findings.test: Reply twice to different messages and tag a synthetic contact; verify target IDs, clear quote state and unmodified mention text.

findings.title: Photos, voice notes, GIFs and videos fail
findings.impact: Users miss photos/context or the last part of audio and must return to native apps.
findings.action: Support media only where qualified; show unsupported content explicitly with a route to the source app. Preserve full audio length.
findings.test: Exercise full voice-note playback, images, video failures and unsupported/view-once types; never silently omit content.

findings.title: Native features vary by network and version
findings.impact: Calls, polls, channel comments and group details do not have consistent parity; a later review praises polls.
findings.action: Publish a per-network capability list, explain unavailable actions and offer a source-app handoff.
findings.test: Run connector-specific capability checks; never display an enabled action that the route cannot perform.
findings.qualification: Historical complaints are not proof of current absence; p90/91 praise polls, while current WhatsApp help lists polls unsupported

findings.title: Deletion and editing are unavailable or undiscoverable
findings.impact: Users cannot clean clutter or distinguish local deletion from deleting a provider message.
findings.action: Separate hide/archive, local deletion and provider deletion; expose qualified edit/delete actions and safe bulk cleanup.
findings.test: Verify each action affects only its stated scope and account; confirm destructive bulk actions clearly.
findings.qualification: Developer replies on p47/87 say deletion exists for some networks; absence, failure and discoverability must be separated

findings.title: Lag, battery drain and update regressions
findings.impact: The hub itself becomes another heavy app and users prefer stable essentials over more features.
findings.action: Keep inbox work light, measure actual battery use, and gate connector/runtime upgrades on regression checks.
findings.test: Measure idle/background and active use on low-RAM and modern phones; verify the inbox survives AI failure.

findings.title: Cloud discomfort and account security warnings
findings.impact: Some users distrust cloud accounts or report provider security restrictions; a centralized inbox also concentrates sensitive history.
findings.action: Prefer qualified phone-local routes, show where data flows, protect credentials and local history, and surface provider security challenges.
findings.test: Inspect data flow and account isolation; show security/reconnect failures without hiding them.
findings.qualification: These reviews do not prove a data breach or establish the cause of a provider restriction

findings.title: Pricing changes break expected workflows
findings.impact: Users object to losing categories, multiple accounts or scheduled messages, especially an already queued send.
findings.action: Make limits and pricing clear before setup; preserve pending work across entitlement changes. Decide pricing after cost validation.
findings.test: Change an entitlement with queued work and show an explicit outcome; disclose account limits before connection.
findings.qualification: Reviewer prices differ and are historical; none are treated as the current price

findings.title: Support replies do not reliably close problems
findings.impact: Some praise support; others report repeated generic replies and unresolved problems.
findings.action: Create privacy-safe diagnostics, traceable issue status and an explanation of what recovery can do.
findings.test: Export diagnostics without message bodies/tokens; reproduce a failure and show the user a concrete recovery outcome.

findings.title: Notification sounds and noise preferences
findings.impact: People want per-person/network sounds and less noise from shared reels.
findings.action: Use Android notification channels and user-controlled noise rules; do not silently classify all shared content as junk.
findings.test: Change one source notification preference and verify important other-source messages still alert.

findings.title: Email, contacts and more network coverage
findings.impact: Users request email, nicknames, contacts, calls, TikTok, Snapchat and Viber; scope expansion competes with stability.
findings.action: Make Gmail, Outlook and Teams first-class scoped providers; assess other networks separately. Keep a contacts view optional.
findings.test: Qualify each requested account type and route before making connection claims.

findings.title: Native-app and cross-device dependencies surprise users
findings.impact: A unified hub is mistaken for a complete native replacement; linked-device renewal and mobile iMessage limitations disappoint users.
findings.action: Disclose device/session dependencies during setup. Multi-device encrypted sync is a later deliberate design, not an implicit promise.
findings.test: Explain and test renewal/handoff behavior; maintain access to native apps where required.
findings.qualification: Current Beeper WhatsApp guide confirms primary-app use every 12-14 days; cannot promise MINI bypasses it

findings.title: Private AI on the phone without a core account
findings.impact: Some users value local models and no hidden payment; privacy is a strong motivation.
findings.action: Retain local English drafting without a MINI cloud account; explain provider sign-in separately.
findings.test: After model setup, draft from synthetic local context in airplane mode.
findings.qualification: Current official project documentation states local inference and no account required for core AI

findings.title: Flexible model choice and useful writing
findings.impact: Successful users praise smooth local models, Hugging Face access and a useful complex letter.
findings.action: Choose a tested default for ordinary users; retain advanced model options only after compatibility qualification.
findings.test: Evaluate useful English communication drafts on target devices; model download alone is not success.

findings.title: Voice can improve hands-free use
findings.impact: A user combines read-aloud speech with keyboard dictation and requests picture input.
findings.action: Consider local voice accessibility after reliable text; distinguish phone dictation from MINI-owned processing.
findings.test: Run a complete offline voice flow with assets present and expose unsupported voice features.

findings.title: Local model library, personas and benchmarking
findings.impact: Custom Pals and model discovery are powerful, but selection and diagnostic tools can become friction.
findings.action: Borrow device qualification and an optional diagnostic benchmark; keep personas/catalogs out of the main reply flow.
findings.test: A normal user can draft without selecting a persona or running a benchmark.
findings.stage: Default model in MVP; advanced tools later
findings.qualification: Distinctive in this sample, not exclusive to PocketPal; p69/83 also report benchmark crashes

findings.title: Downloads fail near completion and waste mobile data
findings.impact: Large failed downloads waste hours and expensive bandwidth; retries may require starting over.
findings.action: Use resumable downloads where the host supports ranges, integrity checks, clear byte size and consent for mobile data.
findings.test: Interrupt at multiple stages, resume or explain unsupported resume, verify checksum, and count transferred bytes.

findings.title: File size and storage requirements are misleading
findings.impact: A reviewer reports a 2.44GB model becoming 4.30GB; free disk space alone does not ensure sufficient runtime memory.
findings.action: Show actual file size, extra installation space, runtime RAM needs and compatibility before downloading.
findings.test: Compare advertised and downloaded bytes; handle disk exhaustion safely and explain RAM separately.
findings.qualification: Reported discrepancy; its cause is not established here

findings.title: App becomes unusable after model download
findings.impact: Crashes on loading, repeated startup crashes and failed recommended models block the first useful action.
findings.action: Never auto-load a repeatedly failing model; provide safe startup, explicit recovery and a working manual inbox.
findings.test: Install an invalid/incompatible synthetic artifact, restart and recover without reinstalling or deleting user conversations.

findings.title: Compatibility is not just model size or RAM
findings.impact: Reports span a 4GB Galaxy A05 and high-end phones; both small and large models fail. One severe kernel-panic report is unverified.
findings.action: Qualify exact model format, tokenizer/template, runtime version and device/backend combination. Do not assume high RAM guarantees success.
findings.test: Run a known model/runtime/device matrix; treat severe device failures as blockers until investigated.
findings.qualification: Reviewer assertions about enough RAM or universal failure are not diagnosed causes

findings.title: Slow or endless loading and generation
findings.impact: Even a greeting can hang; keyboard lag and long waits make on-device AI feel broken.
findings.action: Use bounded load/generation times, responsive cancellation and clear progress; qualify a useful default on low-RAM phones.
findings.test: Measure cold start, first token and completion; cancel a stuck draft and keep the inbox responsive.

findings.title: GPU/NPU hardware claims exceed actual compatibility
findings.impact: Users see CPU-only fallback despite a capable phone; broad hardware marketing creates false expectations.
findings.action: Report the backend actually used and measured performance; select only tested acceleration paths with fallback.
findings.test: Compare detected vs used backend and fallback on Qualcomm and MediaTek target devices.
findings.qualification: Store AI summary p86 is not evidence that every chipset works; current project docs explicitly distinguish supported backends

findings.title: Long conversations fill context and freeze
findings.impact: Replies stop after a few turns or paragraphs; users cannot continue the conversation.
findings.action: Budget context, preserve recent relevant messages, summarize only when qualified, and explain truncation instead of freezing.
findings.test: Use long synthetic threads; verify bounded prompts and no loss of current intent or invented missing details.

findings.title: Switching apps interrupts work
findings.impact: Generation stops/unloads and downloads may stop when backgrounded; users perceive unfinished work as failure.
findings.action: Keep heavy drafting foreground-only for MVP. Save the composer and permitted partial draft, explain interruption and offer a fresh retry on return. Downloads have a separate lifecycle.
findings.test: Switch apps during load, generation and download; verify no hidden model restart, clear cancellation, preserved input and safe download recovery.

findings.title: Empty, repeated or garbled output
findings.impact: Blank replies, repeated characters and off-topic loops are unusable regardless of token speed.
findings.action: Validate engine/template/tokenizer compatibility; evaluate task usefulness and handle empty/failed output plainly.
findings.test: Use English cases with dates, prices, quoted context and user intent; flag empty/repetitive output and allow manual reply.

findings.title: Generic answers and forced personality
findings.impact: Users dislike fake friendliness, misunderstood requests and inappropriate or off-topic output.
findings.action: Draft grounded, concise replies in the user-selected tone; require exact review and never send automatically.
findings.test: Blindly assess English drafts for factual/context accuracy, tone and editing effort; retain romanized Hindi/Telugu exploratory cases.

findings.title: Setup and sign-in boundaries are confusing
findings.impact: People do not know how to load a model, get redirected unexpectedly or believe local Pals require sign-in.
findings.action: Guide the first usable draft; distinguish local AI setup, provider OAuth and optional online catalogs. No unexplained store redirect.
findings.test: Observe setup without coaching; core local drafting works without catalog sign-in.
findings.qualification: Developer p61 says local Pals do not require sign-in; the review establishes confusion, not a proven account requirement

findings.title: Offline and voice behavior is questioned
findings.impact: A reviewer says disabling SIM stopped AI; another says voice needs internet repeatedly. These are trust concerns, not proof of cloud inference.
findings.action: Verify offline drafting and downloaded voice assets separately; disclose network use for downloads and communication sync.
findings.test: After provisioning, restart in airplane mode and measure network attempts with synthetic data; test text and voice separately.
findings.qualification: Unverified reviewer allegations; cannot infer data exfiltration or a privacy breach

findings.title: Readable formatting, images and accessible output
findings.impact: Correct generated math is hard to read without rendering; users ask for image input and spoken interaction.
findings.action: Use clear copyable/editable reply formatting in MVP. Consider math rendering and image/voice input only for demonstrated communication needs.
findings.test: Verify multiline text, copying and large-font display; qualify any later media model input.

findings.title: Updates can introduce regressions
findings.impact: Previously working configurations break; developer replies describe engine and model-support fixes.
findings.action: Pin qualified runtime/model versions and rerun cold-start, repeated-use, cancellation and recovery checks before upgrades.
findings.test: Repeat the accepted device/model workflow after an upgrade with existing local state.
findings.qualification: Developer replies are proposed fixes; reviewers did not verify resolution in these screenshots
